Container.Name: Amcrest-PTZ-Bridge
Container.Overview: Expose the local DVRIP pan and tilt controls of an Amcrest SmartHome camera as an ONVIF PTZ service for Frigate. Video and audio remain direct between the camera and Frigate; this bridge handles movement commands only.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: amcrest dahua dvrip frigate onvif camera pan tilt ptz
Container.Requires: An Amcrest SmartHome PTZ camera reachable from Unraid over local TCP port 37777. Configure one container instance per camera and assign each instance a unique host port.

Config.Name: ONVIF host port
Config.Description: Port Frigate uses to reach this camera's ONVIF PTZ facade. Use a unique host port for each installed camera.

Config.Name: Camera name
Config.Description: Friendly name reported by the ONVIF service.

Config.Name: Camera IP or hostname
Config.Description: LAN address of the Amcrest camera, for example 192.0.2.25 (replace this documentation-only address).

Config.Name: Camera username
Config.Description: Local camera account with PTZ permission.

Config.Name: Camera password
Config.Description: Local camera password. This is masked in the Unraid form but remains available to Docker as a container environment value.

Config.Name: Camera DVRIP port
Config.Description: Local Dahua DVRIP service port. Most Amcrest SmartHome cameras use 37777.

Config.Name: Camera model
Config.Description: Model label reported to ONVIF clients.

Config.Name: Camera channel
Config.Description: DVRIP camera channel. Standalone cameras normally use channel 0.

Config.Name: Maximum move time
Config.Description: Fail-safe maximum movement duration in seconds if an ONVIF Stop request is lost.

Config.Name: Allowed clients
Config.Description: Optional comma-separated IP/CIDR allowlist. Leave empty to accept any client that can reach the published LAN port. Docker NAT may present clients as a 172.16.0.0/12 gateway address.

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: Python log level: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, or ERROR.
